{{Top|canon=Insulated watch cap}}
[[File:Alliance_Cold_Weather_Headgear.jpg|thumb|Alliance Cold Weather Headgear]]
{{Quote|Wear the hat. I don't care if it looks goofy or you can't see. Hypothermia is the alternative.|Alliance [[Quartermaster/Legends|quartermaster]]|<ref name="The Nightsister's Revenge">{{SWGTCG|set=The Nightsister's Revenge|cardname=Alliance Cold Weather Headgear}}</ref>}}
'''Alliance Cold Weather Headgear''' consisted of a special hat, face mask and [[Anti-glare goggles/Legends|protective goggles]], issued to the members of [[Alliance Special Forces/Legends|Alliance Special Forces]] during assignments in extremely frigid climates like [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] as part of their [[Alliance Cold Weather armor|cold-weather outfit]]. Its main and only purpose was to protect the wearer from hypothermia.
